bio: Frances was born at Munzingen on 8 Mar 1863 and baptized two days later as 'Franziska Mayer, legitimate daughter of the local citizen and mason Friedrich Mayer and Maria Anna Birkenmaier, both Catholic' ([R4-S1]). She was the first child born after her parents' marriage in Oct 1862. Her godparents came from both sides of the family: her mother's brother Joseph Birkenmaier, then 20, and her father's sister Paulina Mayer, then 22. The register confirms the tree's birth date exactly. FamilySearch has her later life: she married Philip Miller, lived at Coal Dale (Rahn Twp) and Coaldale in Schuylkill County from 1900, died at Coaldale on 10 Dec 1928, and was buried at St Joseph's RC Cemetery, Summit Hill ([R4-S2]).
